children: Palm oil (FCPOc3) may retest support at 4,903 ringgit per metric ton, a break below may trigger a fall into the 4,843-4,876 ringgit range.
The current fall is riding on a wave c, the third wave of a presumed three-wave cycle from the August 21 high of 5,031 ringgit.
This wave is capable of travelling into a wide range of 4,788 ringgit to 4,876 ringgit, formed by its 100% and the 61.8% projection levels.
Resistance is at 4,964 ringgit; a break above may lead to a gain into the 4,985-5,018 ringgit range.
On the daily chart, the uptrend would keep steady within a rising channel, as long as the market could hover above the support at 4,897 ringgit.
A break below the support would signal either an extension of the correction from 5,031 ringgit, or a reversal of the uptrend from 4,462 ringgit.
The bearish signals on the hourly suggest a break.
